[2026-09-02T01:35:11.673Z] [arbiter] The Arbiter takes you in. "Drakova is lethal country. The things that wake here pull above your weight. 43 HP carries you through Varakush (danger 1). 1/9 Cores recovered. Visit the remaining Lost Capitals. Or move on until you've got your legs under you."
[2026-09-02T01:35:11.675Z] [world] Mercy noses at the blood-spotted cloth and snorts. There's something there.
[2026-09-02T01:35:11.677Z] [world] You've left The Broken Steeple and entered Drakova. A Lost Capital. Lost means sealed, not destroyed. There is a difference. It's afternoon. Thalan is the only soul in sight. east leads to The Drowned Quarter. Nothing named to the north or south or west.

[2026-09-02T01:35:11.677Z] [world] The gate of Drakova stands before you — their ground, not yet their halls. (Tap ENTER OUTPOST to step inside.)
[2026-09-02T01:35:11.680Z] [world] [Drakova] north: The Broken Steeple (3 tiles, 8 hours) · east: The Drowned Quarter (1 tile, 3 hours) · south: The Vault Steps (12 tiles, 1 day, 6 hours) · west: Mud Seas (4 tiles, 10 hours)
[2026-09-02T01:35:11.680Z] [world] A figure crests the rise — Thalan, the Wanderer, pack heavy across the shoulders. They set down to trade.
[2026-09-02T01:35:11.680Z] [arbiter] The Arbiter inclines their head toward the newcomer. "Thalan, the Wanderer. Friendly and talkative, Thalan walks the roadside outposts with a horse and a limited pack. Trades common weapons and tools, sometimes coin advice
."
[2026-09-02T01:35:11.685Z] [world] Rare workings for sale: Ember Storm (200 TC), Fallout Bloom (200 TC), Founder's Edge (500 TC) — buy one by name to learn it. This one also mends worn gear, trains a stat for coin, and patches up a hurt dog or golem — just ask.
[2026-09-02T01:35:11.692Z] [world] Drakova you reach by going down — a throat of hardened Aetherstone mud sealed over a city that never saw the sky again. Your lantern light dies three feet out. The dark here is old, and it is full, and it does not like being looked at.
[2026-09-02T01:35:11.692Z] [arbiter] (Reclaimer route — to recover the Drakova Core, SALVAGE something here. The Aetheric housing comes loose under the right trowel.)
